newsitem.title: UK: Boots dismisses report of Cigna PMI deal.
newsitem.headline: Boots dismisses report of Cigna PMI deal.

text.p: British pharmacy and retailer Boots Co Plc dismissed as "speculation" a report in the Sunday Telegraph newspaper that it might be in talks with U.S.-based Cigna over private medical insurance (PMI) contracts.
But a company spokesman said Boots was interested in the possibility of offering health insurance.
"Health insurance is one of the things we keep on our radar," the spokesman said.
"I wouldn't dismiss the concept that Boots is interested at the right time in the right way in health insurance," he added.
The Sunday Telegraph said Cigna, a healthcare giant, was in talks to provide PMI contracts with a major UK retailer.
It said Cigna marketing director David White had declined to name the group's chosen partner but that talks had been held with several retailers.
The Sunday Telegraph said Cigna was also in talks with a financial services company over creating an own-brand range of PMI contracts. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
